All programs enforce the time budget with time.process_time() and a deadline checked inside the objective or callback, aborting by exception.
alternatives: Check deadline only between optimizer calls
Use a fixed iteration count instead of deadline

proposed.what: All programs use the maximum over all entries of L as ||f*f||_inf and treat the zero endpoints as part of L.
alternatives: Use a softmax approximation in final exact evaluation

proposed.what: All programs return a single nonnegative 1-D NumPy array of heights of length at most 50,000, scored by the exact R formula.
alternatives: Return a parametric function instead of heights

proposed.what: All programs use float64 NumPy arrays and print short progress lines with R, N, and plateau diagnostics.
alternatives: Log to stderr instead of stdout

confirmed.what: All programs minimize the negative of R (or a negative surrogate) rather than a monotone transform of R.
alternatives: Maximize log R instead of R
Maximize R/(1-R) to sharpen near optimum
confirmed.why: Transform changes conditioning and which local optima are reachable.

confirmed.what: All programs align h's steps to the integer grid and read f*f at integer-offset knots; no half-cell shift or staggered grid.
alternatives: Shift h by half a cell before convolution
Use vertex-centered instead of cell-centered h
confirmed.why: Grid phase changes which knot values sample the piecewise-linear f*f and hence R.
